description: Compute unbounded (rolling) retention for daily signup cohorts of the gaming analytics platform at day N in (1, 7, 30). A player is retained at day N if they are active on signup_date + N days OR on any later date. To avoid right-censoring, a (cohort, N) pair is reported only if signup_date + N <= the latest activity_date in the whole dataset. Output columns: cohort_date (DATE), day_n (INT64), cohort_size (INT64), retained_players (INT64), retention_rate (FLOAT64, 4 decimals). Sort by cohort_date, day_n.

activity_date.description: UTC date with at least one session; duplicates possible

edge_cases: Player 2 is active on day 3 only: retained at day 1 (unbounded) but not at day 7
Player 3 is active only on the signup day (day 0) and is never retained
Player 1's activity on day 40 makes them retained at day 30
Cohorts too young to observe day N are omitted for that N rather than reported as 0
common_failure_modes: FM2: Classic (bounded) retention with activity_date = signup_date + N reports day-1 retention of 1/4 instead of 3/4
FM7: Missing censoring guard reports artificially low day-30 retention for recent cohorts
FM1: Joining players to activity and counting rows inflates retained players with multiple qualifying days
